meta.name: geniml
meta.description: This skill should be used when working with genomic interval data (BED files) for machine learning tasks. Use for training region embeddings (Region2Vec, BEDspace), single-cell ATAC-seq analysis (scEmbed), building consensus peaks (universes), or any ML-based analysis of genomic regions. Applies to BED file collections, scATAC-seq data, chromatin accessibility datasets, and region-based genomic feature learning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用机器学习分析基因组区间数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理BED文件或进行基因组区域机器学习
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data with machine learning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if working with BED files or genomic region ML

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理基因组区间数据（BED 文件），训练区域嵌入（Region2Vec）、单细胞 ATAC-seq 嵌入（scEmbed）、构建共识峰集（universe），以及进行基于机器学习的基因组区域分析。
howto.when: 当你需要分析 BED 文件集合、单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据或染色质可及性数据集，进行区域嵌入、聚类或机器学习任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 训练这些 BED 文件的区域嵌入。
用 scEmbed 分析这个单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据并聚类。
say.note: Claude 会生成细胞嵌入并指导聚类。

say.text: 从这些 BED 文件构建一个共识峰集（universe）。
say.note: Claude 会使用 CC 或 HMM 等方法构建。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you work with genomic interval data (BED files) for machine learning tasks, including training region embeddings (Region2Vec), single-cell ATAC-seq embeddings (scEmbed), building consensus peaks (universes), and other ML-based analyses of genomic regions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze BED file collections, single-cell ATAC-seq data, or chromatin accessibility datasets for region embedding, clustering, or ML tasks.

say_en.text: Train region embeddings for these BED files using Region2Vec.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through tokenization and model training.

say_en.text: Analyze this single-cell ATAC-seq data with scEmbed and cluster cells.
say_en.note: Claude will generate cell embeddings and guide clustering.

say_en.text: Build a consensus peak set (universe) from these BED files.
say_en.note: Claude will use methods like CC or HMM to build it.
